{{Quote|Each establishment in this little piece of literature has its own unique flavor. You can sample 'em like sweet-treats, but don't gorge yourself.|[[Cohden K'Reye]]|<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>}}
'''Sweet-treats''' were a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]. They were capable of giving an individual a [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]]-ache if they were gorged on.<ref name="WHSV" />
